description: Compute world-space position from MODEL_MATRIX * VERTEX and write to a varying so fragment ops can read it. REQUIRED for any shader that needs world-XZ in fragment() — Godot 4's `VERTEX` in fragment is VIEW-space, so using it directly would make world-anchored features drift with the camera. Empirical case: 2026-05-18 splatmap drift bug took 4 iterations to diagnose because of this.

world_pos.doc: world-space VERTEX, available to fragment ops via the varying v_world_pos
